verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs provide first-party webhook subscription creation endpoint (POST /v1/webhook-subscription), event types like payroll.paid, HMAC-based payload verification, a verify endpoint for confirming subscriptions, and a health-check endpoint for the webhooks system — a fairly complete webhooks subscription API. This is well documented for API/AI-native integrators building agentic workflows. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of webhook reliability or delivery guarantees, and no evidence of AI-agent-specific tooling for consuming/subscribing to these webhooks (e.g., agent SDK helpers).
